title: Book Three · Chapter 171: A Turn on the Blue Bike
story:
The fourth Friday brings another nine yuan. Ronan's work envelope now holds sixty-three.

That weekend is another household review. Mum and Dad put twelve and eight into the study envelope again.

It is the fourth monthly payment since Ronan's birthday, and the sixth in all. The parents now keep one hundred and twenty yuan for study.

His own sixty-three and twenty and a half stay separate. Together, the three amounts are two hundred and three and a half.

On Sunday afternoon, Dad asks if Ronan wants a walk.

Ronan is putting his notebook away. He looks at the blue bike beside the wall.

“We can take this.”

They push it through the busy corner. At the quiet park path, Ronan holds the handlebar toward Dad.

“Your turn.”

Dad looks at him, then takes the bike. He rides a slow circle while Ronan walks to the bench.

The old bell rings once near the far tree. Ronan turns toward the sound.

Dad comes back and stops beside him.

“Still a good bell.”

“The oldest part.”

Ronan runs a finger along the handlebar. Dad stands with one hand on the seat and looks down the path.

“If you go, will you take the bike?”

“I think it can stay at home.”

Dad nods. He gives the handlebar back. Ronan rides his own circle, with the path clear ahead.

For a little while, he thinks about no forms or totals. He follows the bend, passes the bench, and slows near the gate.

When he returns, Dad is sitting on the bench and looking up through the leaves. Ronan stops and sits beside him.

They talk about Mr Sun's next cupboard. Dad describes a room with a low roof. He draws its shape in the dust with the toe of his shoe.

Ronan follows the line.

“The people still need to stand up.”

“In part of it.”

Dad smiles and draws the higher space beside it. They work out the shape together until a passing child asks what they are drawing.

“A room,” Ronan says.

The child looks at the dust, then at the bike.

“For that?”

Dad laughs. Ronan shakes his head and moves the bike away from their little floor plan.

Later, they push it back through the busy road. Dad carries the empty water bottle. Ronan rolls the bike through the green door and parks it in its usual place beside the wall.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

handlebar＝车把；bend＝弯道；toe＝脚尖；usual place＝平常放的位置。

## 理解问题

1. 这次父母实际存钱后，他们的学习信封与三份合计各是多少？
2. Dad骑了一圈是否表示车已转送给他？车铃与蓝车最后在哪里？

## 读句子

**The old bell rings once near the far tree.**

拆开看：The old bell / rings once / near the far tree.

原来的旧车铃／响了一声／在远处那棵树附近。
